basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Waltham, MA, who recently got into Smite and other MOBAs. My interests revolve around finding new strategies and builds to improve my gameplay. Outside of gaming, I'm a part-time student studying computer science and working as a barista. My online hours are typically in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight EST. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my friends both online and offline. I dislike toxicity in gaming communities but love engaging in discussions about game mechanics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to both Reddit and the Smite community, most of my knowledge comes from actively playing the game and watching YouTube videos or Twitch streams of more experienced players. I also occasionally read through subreddits to learn more about game strategies and updates.
